info.description: Read-only racing database: categories, circuits, drivers, races, teams, engines, chassis, cars and articles.
info.title: RacingDB API

get.description: Retrieve a page of article texts filtered and sorted by query criteria. Returns up to 26 rows: the 26th only signals that a next page exists.

parameters.description: Filter expression in format: column,operator,value (operators: eq neq gt gte lt lte ilike in; in takes values separated by |)
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Sort expression in format: column,direction (e.g. title,asc)
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Retrieve a page of articles filtered and sorted by query criteria. Returns up to 26 rows: the 26th only signals that a next page exists.

parameters.description: Filter expression in format: column,operator,value (operators: eq neq gt gte lt lte ilike in; in takes values separated by |)
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Sort expression in format: column,direction (e.g. published_at,asc)
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Full-text search over article titles, summaries and bodies: whole words, case-insensitive, no stemming. Supports "quoted phrases", or, and -exclusion. One result per article, using the text in `lang` when it qualifies. Without `q`, lists every article newest first. Returns up to 26 rows: the 26th only signals that a next page exists.

parameters.description: Search words (max 200 characters); omit to browse
parameters.name: q
